title: Mock: Car Rental System
summary: Branches, cars, date-range search, reservations without overlap, cancellation and late-return fees.
hints: Days are integers, and a reservation covers `[startDay, endDay)`. It's the same half-open overlap test as the meeting rooms.
Per car, keep a list of active reservations. Availability means no active reservation overlaps.
Search: filter cars by city (via their branch) and type, keep the available ones, then sort by (rate, id).
Late fee: `extraDays × rate × 3 / 2`. Early return doesn't refund anything.
